title: Email/parse conflates blobNotFound with notParsable
description: email.rs:869-886 — backend.parse_email() returns Err for both 'blob not found' and 'not a valid RFC 5322 message'. Handler puts ALL errors in notParsable. RFC 8621 §5.8 requires: blob not found → notFound; exists but unparseable → notParsable. The not_found Vec is declared but never populated. Clients relying on notFound to detect missing blobs will silently get incorrect notParsable entries.
